title: Omarchy Hotkeys
subtitle: Every shortcut on this computer, plus your own
customNone: None yet. Add one with: omarchy-hotkeys add, or the "Custom hotkeys" app.
officialMissing: The manual chapter was not found on this computer.
plane.superCtrl: Super + Ctrl: panels and system menus
printHint: Tip: press Ctrl + P to print or save as PDF.
restored: Shortcut %1 is back to Omarchy's default
notFound: %1 is not in your custom shortcuts
conflict: %1 is already used for "%2". Use --force to replace it.
badKeys: Not a valid shortcut: %1 (example: SUPER + ALT + T)
badText: Description and command cannot be empty or contain | or line breaks
noModifier: Warning: %1 has no Super/Ctrl/Alt — it will fire whenever you press that key.
promptDesc: What it does (shown in Super + K)
promptCmd: Command to run (e.g. ghostty, chromium https://…)
pickDisable: Pick a default shortcut to turn off
installedBody: Open "Hotkey manual" or "Custom hotkeys" from the app launcher (Super + Space)
cmdMissing: Warning: the command "%1" was not found on this computer — the shortcut will do nothing until it is installed.
docLua: Omarchy loads custom hotkey files (Lua config)
docNoLua: This Omarchy version does not load custom hotkey files (no Lua config). Please update Omarchy: omarchy update
docNoFile: The custom hotkey file is missing — run: omarchy-hotkeys apply
docErrors: Hyprland reports errors in the config:
docNotBound: %1 is NOT active in Hyprland — the file was not loaded or was rejected
docCmdMissing: command NOT found: %1 — install it or use the full path
docStillOn: %1 should be off but is still active
docSuper: If nothing happens at all when you press Super shortcuts, the computer around Omarchy (Windows, a virtual machine) may be catching the Super key: click inside the Omarchy window first, or try Omarchy's own Super + K.
docTest: Test a hotkey's command now: omarchy-hotkeys test "<keys>"
menuDoctor: Check why a shortcut does nothing
wizPlane: Which keys do you hold down?
wizPickKey: Pick the last key (only free keys are listed)
wizNoFree: Every key in this group is taken — pick another group.
badUrl: That does not look like a web address (it should start with https://)
recPrompt: Now press the key combination you want, e.g. Super + F1   (Esc cancels, 20 seconds)
recUsed: It is used now for "%1" — saving replaces it.
recUnavailable: Recording keys needs Hyprland; pick the keys from a list instead.
